Returns `{ kind: "prepared", preparationId, revision, sourceDigest }`.

#### `dohc dataset approve`

Approve prepared source.

Take preparationId and revisionSha256 from the reviewed preparation. agentLabel is an optional label supplied by the agent. With --as-agent, and always through MCP, agentLabel is recorded as agent-declared. Without it, no agent identity is recorded. Automation runs cannot approve or publish.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `agentLabel`: `string`
- `preparationId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `revisionSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "approved", revision }`.

#### `dohc dataset discard`

Discard prepared source. The files stay in place.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `preparationId`: `UUID`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "discarded" }`.

#### `dohc dataset prepareMigration`

Prepare new source and migration SQL for review.

Read more changed records with migrationPreviewPage. Review the result, then approve it with approveMigration.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetPath`: `string`. Required.
- `expectedDatasetId`: `UUID`
- `migrationPath`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "migration-prepared", preparationId, previousRevision, revision, expected: { workspaceId, datasetId, hostEpoch, approvedRevisionHash, revision, digest }, candidate: { candidateId, expected, approvedRevisionHash, checkpointSha256, expiresAtMs, preview }, sourceDigest, approvalDigest, schemaSql, operationSource, migrationSql, expiresAtMs }`.

#### `dohc dataset migrationPreviewPage`

Read more records a prepared migration changes.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `preparationId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `after`: `string`
- `limit`: `integer`

Returns `{ kind: "migration-preview-page", changes: { kind, table, key, before, after }[], nextCursor }`.

#### `dohc dataset prepareSchemaChange`

Prepare one field, table, or name change.

change.kind is one of renameCollection, renameTable, renameField, changeField, addButton, addField. Review the result, then approve it with approveMigration.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetPath`: `string`. Required.
- `expectedDatasetId`: `UUID`
- `revision`: `integer`. Required.
- `revisionSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `change`: `{ kind: "renameCollection", name: string } | { kind: "renameTable", tableId: UUID, name: string } | { kind: "renameField", tableId: UUID, fieldId: UUID, name: string } | { kind: "changeField", tableId: UUID, fieldId: UUID, type: "text" | "number" | "checkbox" | "date" | "select" | "multi-select" | "url" | "attachment" | "relation", required: boolean } | { kind: "addButton", tableId: UUID, name: string } | { kind: "addField", tableId: UUID, field: { name: string, type: "text" | "number" | "checkbox" | "date" | "select" | "multi-select" | "url" | "attachment", required: boolean, unique: boolean, default?: any JSON, options?: string[] } }`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "migration-prepared", preparationId, previousRevision, revision, expected: { workspaceId, datasetId, hostEpoch, approvedRevisionHash, revision, digest }, candidate: { candidateId, expected, approvedRevisionHash, checkpointSha256, expiresAtMs, preview }, sourceDigest, approvalDigest, schemaSql, operationSource, migrationSql, expiresAtMs }`.

#### `dohc dataset approveMigration`

Apply a reviewed migration.

Take revisionSha256 and approvalDigest from the preparation. Approval applies the reviewed result without rerunning the SQL. agentLabel is an optional label supplied by the agent. With --as-agent, and always through MCP, agentLabel is recorded as agent-declared. Without it, no agent identity is recorded. Automation runs cannot approve or publish.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `agentLabel`: `string`
- `preparationId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `revisionSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `approvalDigest`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "migrated", revision, cursor: { workspaceId, datasetId, hostEpoch, approvedRevisionHash, revision, digest } }`.

#### `dohc dataset discardMigration`

Discard a prepared migration.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `preparationId`: `UUID`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "migration-discarded" }`.

#### `dohc dataset invoke`

Run an approved operation.

Use describe to find approved operation IDs. Retry an uncertain write with the same input and idempotencyKey.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetPath`: `string`. Required.
- `expectedDatasetId`: `UUID`
- `operationId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `revision`: `integer`. Required.
- `revisionSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `input`: `any JSON`. Required.
- `idempotencyKey`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "invoked", result, revision, replayed, copy?: { offline, savedAtMs, coverage?: "saved-pages" } }` or `{ kind: "refused", code, message }`.

### `dohc app`

```sh
dohc app <verb> '<JSON>'
```

Approve, open, and share apps.

Each verb takes one JSON object that names workspaceId. Find workspaceId in .dohc/manifest.json at the workspace root.

#### `dohc app createLink`

Create a scoped app link at View access by default.

appRoot and paths resolve from your current folder (the workspace root through MCP). paths default to the app root. access defaults to view. Generate operationId as a UUID for this creation. Reuse operationId for retries. A link URL is a bearer credential at its stated access level, usable by anyone holding it. Append the published appQuery before the fragment of any link URL, including one returned by createLink. agentLabel is an optional label supplied by the agent. With --as-agent, and always through MCP, agentLabel is recorded as agent-declared. Without it, no agent identity is recorded. Automation runs cannot approve or publish.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `appRoot`: `string`. Required.
- `paths`: `string[]`
- `access`: `"view" | "comment" | "edit"`
- `operationId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `agentLabel`: `string`

Returns `{ kind: "linkCreated", shareId, grantId, selector: { paths, versionId }, access, bearerWarning, url }` or `{ kind: "urlUnavailable", shareId, grantId, selector: { paths, versionId }, access, bearerWarning }`.

#### `dohc app listLocal`

List an app's publications on this computer.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `appRoot`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "localListed", publications: ({ publicationId, authorityRevision, appRoot, sourceRevision, approved, active, datasetCapability } | { publicationId, authorityRevision, appRoot, sourceRevision, approved, active, collectionCapability, pendingCreates })[] }`.

#### `dohc app prepareLocal`

Prepare an app to open on this computer.

Review the source and the Collection access it asks for, then approve.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `appRoot`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "prepared", approvalId, candidateDigest, appRoot, versionId, sourceRevision, audience?: { shareId, grantId, selector, access }, sourcePaths, capabilities, externalNetwork: true, local?: true }`.

#### `dohc app launchLocal`

Get a local URL for an approved app.

The URL works on this computer while dohc is open. It is not a share link.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `publicationId`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "localLaunched", publicationId, url }`.

#### `dohc app list`

List an app's shared publications.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `appRoot`: `string`. Required.
- `cursor`: `SHA-256 hex`

Returns `{ kind: "listed", publications: ({ operatorTakedown?, approvalProvenance?, publicationId, authorityRevision, shareId, grantId, active, linkCurrent, collectionCapability, datasetCapability, manifestUnavailable: false, appRoot, sourceRevision } | { operatorTakedown?, approvalProvenance?, publicationId, authorityRevision, shareId, grantId, active, linkCurrent, collectionCapability, datasetCapability, manifestUnavailable: true })[], nextCursor }`.

#### `dohc app prepare`

Prepare an app for a share link.

Set `shareId` to `shareId` from `createLink`. Set `grantId` to `grantId` from `createLink`. shareId and grantId name the share and its link grant. Review the result, then approve.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `appRoot`: `string`. Required.
- `shareId`: `string`. Required.
- `grantId`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "prepared", approvalId, candidateDigest, appRoot, versionId, sourceRevision, audience?: { shareId, grantId, selector, access }, sourcePaths, capabilities, externalNetwork: true, local?: true }`.

#### `dohc app approve`

Publish a prepared app.

Set `approvalId` to `approvalId` from `prepare`. Set `candidateDigest` to `candidateDigest` from `prepare`. Take approvalId and candidateDigest from prepare, prepareLocal, or reviewReactivation. Append the returned appQuery before the fragment of any link URL, including one returned by createLink. For linkReads, select operationId from the prepared dataset capability's operations and fieldIds from each operation's fields[].fieldId. These selections expose reads to link holders. agentLabel is an optional label supplied by the agent. With --as-agent, and always through MCP, agentLabel is recorded as agent-declared. Without it, no agent identity is recorded. Automation runs cannot approve or publish.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `approvalId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `candidateDigest`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `agentLabel`: `string`
- `linkReads`: `({ operationId: UUID, fieldIds: UUID[] })[]`

Returns `{ kind: "published", publicationId, authorityRevision, local?: true, appQuery?, access?, bearerWarning? }`.

#### `dohc app cancel`

Discard a prepared app before approval.

Set `approvalId` to `approvalId` from `prepare`. Use approvalId from prepareLocal or reviewReactivation to cancel those preparations.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `approvalId`: `UUID`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "cancelled" }`.

#### `dohc app withdraw`

Stop a shared publication.

Set `publicationId` to `publications[].publicationId` from `list`. Set `expectedAuthorityRevision` to `publications[].authorityRevision` from `list`. For an app approved on this computer, take publicationId and authorityRevision from listLocal. withdrawalUnconfirmed means access ended, but responses the app sent earlier are not yet confirmed saved or refused. Withdraw again with the returned authorityRevision to confirm.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `publicationId`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `expectedAuthorityRevision`: `integer`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "withdrawn", publicationId, authorityRevision }` or `{ kind: "withdrawalUnconfirmed", publicationId, authorityRevision, unresolvedCreates }`.

#### `dohc app revokeCollection`

Remove a shared publication's Collection access.

Set `publicationId` to `publications[].publicationId` from `list`. Set `expectedAuthorityRevision` to `publications[].authorityRevision` from `list`. For an app approved on this computer, this ends its approval, as withdraw does.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `publicationId`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `expectedAuthorityRevision`: `integer`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "collectionRevoked", publicationId, authorityRevision }` or `{ kind: "withdrawalUnconfirmed", publicationId, authorityRevision, unresolvedCreates }`.

#### `dohc app reviewReactivation`

Prepare a stopped publication to publish again.

Review the result, then approve.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `publicationId`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "prepared", approvalId, candidateDigest, appRoot, versionId, sourceRevision, audience?: { shareId, grantId, selector, access }, sourcePaths, capabilities, externalNetwork: true, local?: true }`.

#### `dohc app responses`

List responses link holders sent through a share link.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `grantId`: `string`. Required.
- `publicPrincipalId`: `string`
- `afterAcceptanceId`: `string`
- `limit`: `integer`

Returns `{ action: "list", acceptances: { kind: "accepted", acceptanceId, objectId, momentId, publicPrincipalId, versionId, collectionPath, path, acceptedAtMs }[], nextAcceptanceId }`.

#### `dohc app undo-responses`

Remove responses link holders sent through a share link.

operationId names this removal. Retry failed items with the same operationId.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `grantId`: `string`. Required.
- `publicPrincipalId`: `string`
- `afterAcceptanceId`: `string`
- `limit`: `integer`
- `operationId`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ action: "undo", items: { acceptanceId, status, momentId? }[], nextCursor }`.

### `dohc file`

Change workspace files.

Undo removes the copy while it is unchanged.

#### `dohc file duplicate`

```sh
dohc file duplicate <path> [options]
```

Duplicate one file beside its source.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, operationId, undo: { available: true } | { available: false, reason, paths }, path, materialized }`.

### `dohc history`

Read History changes and undo deletes, moves, and renames.

Changes come from the active version of the workspace.

#### `dohc history operation`

```sh
dohc history operation <operation> [options]
```

List the paths changed by one operation.

- `--cursor <cursor>`: Continue from the cursor on the previous operation page.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, operationId, members: { momentId, operation, path, beforePath? }[], withoutHistory?, links?: { state: "updating" } | { state: "done", documents, unchecked, uncheckedCount }, nextCursor }`.

#### `dohc history undo`

```sh
dohc history undo <operation> [options]
```

Undo a delete, move, or rename recorded in History.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, tracked: { state, momentCount }, restored, remaining: { path, reason, retry }[] }`.

#### `dohc history list`

```sh
dohc history list [<path>] [options]
```

List changes to files, newest first.

With a path, list that file's own changes, across its renames. Each line starts with the change's ID.

- `--limit <count>`: List at most this many changes. The default is 50, the most 500.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, changes: { operationId?, id, recordedAtMs, source: "workspace-engine", operation, path, versionId, authors?, fileCount: 1, files? }[], count, totalAvailable, hasMore, cursorMs }`.

#### `dohc history show`

```sh
dohc history show <change> [options]
```

Print a file's text as one change left it.

Find the change's ID with history list. With --json, print both sides and the change's details.

- `--before`: Print the text from before the change instead.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, change: { operationId?, id, recordedAtMs, source: "workspace-engine", operation, path, versionId, authors?, fileCount: 1, files, before, after } }`.

### `dohc version`

Read and change the workspace's versions and their open conflicts.

Versions belong to the owning workspace. A change first saves the edits open in dohc, or refuses when dohc can't.

#### `dohc version list`

```sh
dohc version list [options]
```

List the versions and which one is active.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, versions: { kind, id, name, createdAtMs, canMergeIntoMain }[], activeVersionId }`.

#### `dohc version compare`

```sh
dohc version compare <version> [options]
```

List the files that differ between Main and a version.

Name a version by its name or ID, as version list prints them. With --json, print both sides' text.

- `--after <path>`: Continue after this path from the previous page.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, version: { id, name }, files: { path, status, currentText?, incomingText?, binary? }[], nextAfterPath }`.

#### `dohc version conflicts`

```sh
dohc version conflicts [options]
```

List open conflicts from merges and from sync.

With --json, print each conflict's sides.

- `--after <conflict>`: Continue after this conflict ID from the previous page.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, conflicts: { conflictId, path, sourceVersionId, targetVersionId, origin, contentKind, currentText, incomingText, baseText, currentBinary?, incomingBinary?, baseBinary? }[], nextAfterConflictId }`.

#### `dohc version create`

```sh
dohc version create <name> [options]
```

Create a version from the active one and switch to it.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, version: { id, name } }`.

#### `dohc version switch`

```sh
dohc version switch <version> [options]
```

Switch the workspace folder to a version.

Name a version by its name or ID, as version list prints them.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, version: { id, name }, changedFileCount }`.

#### `dohc version merge`

```sh
dohc version merge <version> [options]
```

Merge a version into Main.

Only versions made from Main can merge into Main. Prints the open conflicts the merge leaves.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, version: { id, name }, mergedFileCount, unchangedFileCount, conflictCount, conflicts: { conflictId, path, sourceVersionId, targetVersionId, origin, contentKind, currentText, incomingText, baseText, currentBinary?, incomingBinary?, baseBinary? }[], nextAfterConflictId }`.

#### `dohc version resolve`

```sh
dohc version resolve <conflict> [-] [options]
```

Resolve an open conflict.

Use - to read the combined text from stdin. Give exactly one of --keep, --text or -. In a merge, current is Main and incoming is the version. In sync, current is this computer.

- `--keep <side>`: Keep current or incoming, as version conflicts names the sides.
- `--text <text>`: Replace both sides with this combined text.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, conflicts: { conflictId, path, sourceVersionId, targetVersionId, origin, contentKind, currentText, incomingText, baseText, currentBinary?, incomingBinary?, baseBinary? }[], nextAfterConflictId }`.

### `dohc automation`

Press Button fields, read an automation's runs, and try a failed run again.

Name a Collection by its folder in the workspace, and an automation by its id in the Collection's automations.yaml. Each computer keeps the runs of the automations it ran. Try again follows the same rules as in dohc.

#### `dohc automation list`

```sh
dohc automation list <collection> [options]
```

Read a Collection's automation definitions and on/off file state.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, definitions }`.

#### `dohc automation switch`

```sh
dohc automation switch <collection> <automation> <on|off> [options]
```

Switch one automation on or off in its file.

- `--base <hash>`: Use the contentHash returned by automation list.
- `--submit-id <id>`: Identify this switch. After an unknown save, read definitions and sync state before retrying.
- `--reformat`: Confirm losing comments and hand formatting in automations.yaml.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, result }`.

#### `dohc automation buttons`

```sh
dohc automation buttons <collection> [options]
```

Inspect Button fields and the actions they require you to confirm.

- `--table <table>`: Inspect the buttons in this dataset table.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, buttons: { field, table?, state }[] }`.

#### `dohc automation runs`

```sh
dohc automation runs <collection> <automation> [options]
```

List an automation's runs on this computer, newest first.

Lists 20 runs at a time, newest first, as the Automations panel does. Each line starts with the run's ID. When older runs remain, the last line gives the --page value that lists them.

- `--page <page>`: List the older runs the last line of an earlier listing names.
- `--server`: List the runs of the workspace's self-hosted server instead.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, runs: { run, state, error, createdAtMs, updatedAtMs, trigger, definitionChanged, neverStarted, chainStopped, undone, unsentChangesLost?: true, changes }[], next }`.

#### `dohc automation run`

```sh
dohc automation run <collection> <automation> <run> [options]
```

Show one run: what started it, what each step changed, and why it failed.

Steps count from 1 in the order automations.yaml lists them, including the steps inside if and otherwise. A step that changed nothing is not listed.

- `--server`: Show a run of the workspace's self-hosted server. It lists what the run changed, without steps.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, run: { run, state, error, createdAtMs, updatedAtMs, trigger, definitionChanged, neverStarted, chainStopped, undone, unsentChangesLost?: true, findMs?, planMs?, writeMs?, writeCount?, steps, failedStep, startsOver } | { run, state, error, createdAtMs, updatedAtMs, trigger, definitionChanged, neverStarted, chainStopped, undone, unsentChangesLost?: true, server: true, changes } }`.

#### `dohc automation retry`

```sh
dohc automation retry <collection> <automation> <run> [options]
```

Try a failed run again. It resumes after the last step that finished.

Only the computer that ran it can try a run again. Anywhere else, the command names that computer.

- `--start-over`: Run it from the first step when the automation changed since the run failed. This can repeat changes the run already made.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, status: "queued" }`.

#### `dohc automation press`

```sh
dohc automation press <collection> <button> <record> [options]
```

Press a Button field on one record, as a person clicks it in dohc.

Name the record by its id, or a dataset record by its primary key as JSON. The press prints the id of the run it started. Follow it with automation run. With --as-agent, the press is recorded as the agent's, for you. A press from an agent run that an automation started is the agent's too, and counts in that chain of automations, which stops after 4 steps. In a shared view, a press goes to the owner's computer, which runs it, as in dohc.

- `--table <table>`: Name the table when the button is in more than one table of a dataset Collection.
- `--confirm <action>`: Run this action, which dohc cannot undo. The press names each action it would run. Repeat for more actions.
- `--request-id <id>`: Send the same id again, after a timeout for example, to get the same press instead of a second one.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, run, outcome, error, waiting }` or `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, relayed: true }`.

### `dohc account`

Review and delete the server account the dohc app is connected to.

Unlike other commands, account verbs also work outside a workspace folder.

#### `dohc account deletePreview`

```sh
dohc account deletePreview [options]
```

List what deleting the connected server account removes.

The result holds the server and previewToken that delete needs. The token expires after five minutes.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, email, server, workspaces: { workspaceId, name }[], workspacesElsewhere, storedBytes, ownedShareCount, heldGrantCount, previewToken }`.

#### `dohc account delete`

```sh
dohc account delete [options]
```

Delete the connected server account and the workspaces it owns on the server.

dohc reads the account password from stdin, or asks for it when stdin is a terminal. Never pass it as an argument. This cannot be undone. Copies on this computer stay. People you shared with lose access and keep their copies. If you create an account again later, the server will not accept your old copies of the deleted workspaces. Its backups keep the data until they expire. When the server cannot finish at once, the account stays blocked and the server finishes later. Either way, the dohc app disconnects from the server. If it cannot, delete exits 1 and says how to finish. If the preview expired or changed, run deletePreview again.

- `--server <address>`: Use server from deletePreview. Required.
- `--preview-token <token>`: Use previewToken from deletePreview. Required.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, ok: true, finished, email, server, disconnectError }`.

## App channel

An app page reads and changes its Collection through the app channel. The channel works in two places: a published app opened from a share link, and a local app opened with `dohc app launchLocal`. An app open in a dohc tab has no channel.

When the page loads, its parent window posts `{ kind: "dohc-app-channel", version: 1 }` with one `MessagePort`. The page keeps that port and posts each request to it as `{ id, op, ...fields }`. `id` is 1 to 64 letters, digits, `_`, or `-`, and no two requests in flight share one. The port answers `{ id, ok: true, value }`, or `{ id, ok: false, status }` with status 400, 404, 409, 413, 429, or 503. At most four requests can wait at once.

The app calls only the operations its owner approved when publishing it. `app.publish.json` names them under `dataset.operationIds`. The page never sends a workspace, user, or revision, because the host supplies them.

### `backend.invoke`

Calls one operation the app's publication exposes, by name. Reads use it too, with a new `idempotencyKey` for each call. Retry an uncertain write with the same `input` and `idempotencyKey`.

Fields: `operation`, `input`, `idempotencyKey`.

Answers `{ result, revision, replayed }`. A refusal from the operation arrives as status 409 with `error: { code, message }`.

### `backend.upload`

Uploads one file, at most 5 MiB, for a later operation to attach.

Fields: `name`, `contentType`, `bytesBase64`, `idempotencyKey`.

Answers `{ file, replayed }`.

### `backend.file`

Reads an uploaded file through an exposed read operation.

Fields: `fileId`, `operation`, `input`.

Answers `{ file, bytesBase64 }`.

### `backend.attempt`

Saves, reads, or clears one unconfirmed submission for an operation, so the page can retry it after a reload. `request` is `{ action: "get" }`, `{ action: "save", idempotencyKey, input }`, or `{ action: "clear", token }`.

Fields: `operation`, `request`.

Answers `{ attempt: { token, idempotencyKey, input } | null }`.

### `collection.list`

Lists records of the document Collection a published app binds to, at most 100 at a time. Add `afterPath` to read the next page. Only a published app opened from a share link can send it.

Fields: `limit`.

Answers `{ records: { path, recordId, fields }[], nextPath }`.

### `collection.create`

Adds a record to that Collection. Only a published app opened from a share link can send it.

Fields: `fields`, `idempotencyKey`.

Answers `{ kind: "accepted", acceptanceId, acceptedAtMs, momentId, objectId, path }`.
